newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgacom sees strong profit growth ahead.
newsitem.headline: Belgacom sees strong profit growth ahead.

text.p: John Goossens, chief executive officer of Belgian part-privatised telecommunications company Belgacom, said he was optimistic there had been further double-digit profit growth in the second half of 1996 and that this would continue in 1997.

"In our first half year we had sales growth of about nine percent. Due to our performance in the second half we will do better than that. In terms of bottom-line earnings after tax ....we will do better than the 15 percent growth we achieved in the first half," he told a news conference.
"In 1997 we can maintain double-digit growth," he added.
Belgacom is 49.9 percent owned by a consortium led by Chicago-based Ameritech. It includes Singapore Telecom, Tele Danmark and three Belgian companies. The Belgian state owns the rest of the shares.
